summary: one account holds a G signer and a P signer over the same ed25519 key
method: core-golden mutation: a successful SetOptions adds an ed25519 signer K2 to an account that already has an ed25519 signer K1; K2 is rewritten to a CAP-40 signed-payload signer over K1 (32-byte payload) in the envelope and in every entry of that account in the ledger's meta, with signers (and signerSponsoringIDs) re-sorted in core's SignerKey order; tx hash recomputed with the core test passphrase
not_preserved: transaction signatures (they sign the original transaction)
the ledger header's scpValue.txSetHash (it hashes the original transaction set)
